papers.title: Static and Dynamic Graph Alignment Network for Temporal Video Grounding
papers.authors: Zhanjie Hu, Bolin Zhang, Jianhua Wang, Jianbo Zheng, Chenchen Yan, Takahiro Komamizu, Ichiro Ide, Jiangbo Qian
papers.tags: video segmentation, tracking, multimodal learning, visual grounding, video search
papers.affiliations: Ningbo University, Inner Mongolia University, Hunan Normal University, Georg-August-Universität Göttingen, Nagoya University
papers.intro: 本文提出静态与动态图对齐网络（SDGAN），通过联合建模静态和动态视觉特征、引入查询-片段对比学习与自适应图建模，以及采用渐进式易到难训练策略，有效解决了时序视频定位中视觉表示不完整、查询无关图构建和单一粒度训练三大问题。

papers.title: AIDA-ReID: Adaptive Intermediate Domain Adaptation for Generalizable and Source-Free Person Re-Identification
papers.authors: Sundas Iqbal, Qing Tian, Danish Ali, Jianping Gou, Weihua Oue
papers.affiliations: School of Software, Nanjing University of Information Science and Technology; Wuxi Institute of Technology, Nanjing University of Information Science and Technology; School of Computer Science, Wuhan University; School of Computer and Information Science, Southwest University; School of Big Data and Computer Science, Guizhou Normal University
papers.intro: 本文提出 AIDA/SF-MIDA，一个反馈调节的自适应中间域学习框架，通过多源中间域生成、伪镜像正则化和动态反馈控制，在不依赖目标域数据的情况下实现行人重识别的跨域泛化与 source-free 部署。

papers.title: WindowsWorld: A Process-Centric Benchmark of Autonomous GUI Agents in Professional Cross-Application Environments
papers.authors: Jinchao Li, Yunxin Li, Chenrui Zhao, Zhenran Xu, Baotian Hu, Min Zhang
papers.affiliations: Harbin Institute of Technology, Shenzhen; Shenzhen Loop Area Institute
papers.intro: 本文提出了WindowsWorld，一个以过程为中心的、针对跨应用专业工作流的GUI代理基准测试，通过人类参与的多代理框架自动生成181个任务（78%为多应用），并引入中间检查点评估，揭示了当前顶级模型在多应用任务上成功率低于21%的显著差距。

papers.title: AttriBE: Quantifying Attribute Expressivity in Body Embeddings for Recognition and Identification
papers.authors: Basudha Pal, Siyuan Huang, Anirudh Nanduri, Zhaoyang Wang, Rama Chellappa
papers.affiliations: Johns Hopkins University（电气与计算机工程系）；Anirudh Nanduri 属于 University of Maryland, College Park；Zhaoyang Wang 属于 Johns Hopkins University（计算机科学系）
papers.intro: 本文提出一个基于互信息神经估计（MINE）的属性表达性（expressivity）分析框架，首次在Transformer-based行人重识别嵌入中量化性别、BMI、Pitch、Yaw等身体属性的编码强度，并扩展至可见光与多种红外（SWIR/MWIR/LWIR）跨光谱场景。

papers.title: CO-EVO: Co-evolving Semantic Anchoring and Style Diversification for Federated DG-ReID
papers.authors: Fengchun Zhang, Qiang Ma, Liuyu Xiang, Jinshan Lai, Tingxuan Huang, Jianwei Hu
papers.affiliations: Fengchun Zhang - University of Electronic Science and Technology of China Qiang Ma - QiYuan Lab Liuyu Xiang - Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications Jinshan Lai - University of Electronic Science and Technology of China Tingxuan Huang - Tsinghua University Jianwei Hu - QiYuan Lab
papers.intro: CO-EVO提出了一种联合进化机制，通过相机不变的语义锚定（CSA）和基于全局相机风格库的风格多样化（GSD）协同优化，解决了联邦域泛化行人重识别中的语义-风格冲突，实现了跨域泛化性能的显著提升。

papers.title: UpstreamQA: A Modular Framework for Explicit Reasoning on Video Question Answering Tasks
papers.authors: Jason Nguyen, Ameet Rao, Alexander Chang, Ishaan Kumar, Erin Tan
papers.tags: multimodal learning, visual question answering, video segmentation, scene understanding, video search
papers.affiliations: Lincoln North Star High School, The Charter School of Wilmington, Greenwich High School, Santa Susana High School, UC Berkeley
papers.intro: UpstreamQA提出一个模块化两阶段框架，通过多模态大型推理模型（LRMs）执行对象识别和场景上下文生成等上游推理任务，再将推理结果传递给下游LMMs进行VideoQA，系统评估显式推理对视频问答性能和可解释性的影响。

papers.title: From Global to Local: Rethinking CLIP Feature Aggregation for Person Re-Identification
papers.authors: Aotian Zheng, Winston Sun, Bahaa Alattar, Vitaly Ablavsky, Jenq-Neng Hwang
papers.affiliations: University of Washington（作者1、2、3、5隶属于Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering；作者4隶属于Applied Physics Laboratory, University of Washington，同时与作者1、2、3、5同属University of Washington）
papers.intro: 论文提出SAGA-ReID（Structured Anchor-Guided Aggregation for Re-Identification），通过将CLIP的文本嵌入空间参数化为结构化锚向量，并让中间层图像patch token以锚作为键和值进行交叉注意力重构，从而实现对遮挡鲁棒的、无需逐图像…

papers.title: VLAA-GUI: Knowing When to Stop, Recover, and Search, A Modular Framework for GUI Automation
papers.authors: Qijun Han, Haoqin Tu, Zijun Wang, Haoyue Dai, Yiyang Zhou, Nancy Lau, Alvaro A. Cardenas, Yuhui Xu, Ran Xu, Caiming Xiong, Zeyu Zheng, Huaxiu Yao, Yuyin Zhou, Cihang Xie
papers.affiliations: UC Santa Cruz (Qijun Han, Haoqin Tu, Zijun Wang, Nancy Lau, Alvaro A. Cardenas, Yuyin Zhou, Cihang Xie), CMU (Haoyue Dai), UNC-Chapel Hill (Yiyang Zhou, Huaxiu Yao), Salesforce (Yuhui Xu, Ran Xu, Caiming Xiong), UC Berkeley (Zeyu Zheng)
papers.intro: 本文提出VLAA-GUI，一个模块化GUI代理框架，通过三个核心组件（完整性验证器、循环中断器、搜索代理）分别解决代理何时停止、恢复和搜索的问题，在OSWorld和WindowsAgentArena上取得SOTA性能，并在OSWorld上首次使多个骨干模型超越人类水平。

papers.title: Temporal Prototyping and Hierarchical Alignment for Unsupervised Video-based Visible-Infrared Person Re-Identification
papers.authors: Zhiyong Li, Wei Jiang, Haojie Liu, Mingyu Wang, Wanchong Xu, Weijie Mao
papers.affiliations: 浙江大学（Zhejiang University）与浙江水利水电学院（Zhejiang University of Water Resources and Electric Power），具体分工见第十二节。
papers.intro: 本文提出HiTPro（Hierarchical Temporal Prototyping），一种无需硬伪标签分配的原型驱动框架，通过时间感知特征编码、相机内轨迹原型构建和层次化跨原型对齐，实现了完全无监督的视频级可见光-红外行人重识别。

papers.title: Thinking Before Matching: A Reinforcement Reasoning Paradigm Towards General Person Re-Identification
papers.authors: Quan Zhang, Jingze Wu, Jialong Wang, Xiaohua Xie, Jianhuang Lai, Hongbo Chen
papers.affiliations: Sun Yat-sen University（中山大学）；Alibaba Cloud Computing（阿里云计算）
papers.intro: 该论文提出ReID-R，一种将链式思维（Chain-of-Thought, CoT）和强化学习引入人重识别的推理驱动范式，通过两阶段训练（判别性推理预热＋高效强化学习），仅用14.3K非平凡数据（约为现有数据规模的20.9%）即可达到与SOTA方法竞争的性能，并能为匹配结果提供高质量的可解释性推理过…

papers.title: Human-Guided Harm Recovery for Computer Use Agents
papers.authors: Christy Li, Sky CH-Wang, Andi Peng, Andreea Bobu
papers.affiliations: MIT CSAIL, Abridge, humans&, MIT CSAIL
papers.intro: 本文形式化了计算机使用代理的“harm recovery”问题，通过用户研究提取人类偏好的多属性评估框架，训练奖励模型重排恢复计划，并引入BackBench基准，实验表明该框架显著优于基线和基于rubric的scaffold。

papers.title: HABIT: Chrono-Synergia Robust Progressive Learning Framework for Composed Image Retrieval
papers.authors: Zixu Li, Yupeng Hu, Zhiwei Chen, Shiqi Zhang, Qinlei Huang, Zhiheng Fu, Yinwei Wei
papers.affiliations: School of Software, Shandong University
papers.intro: 提出HABIT框架，通过互信息转移率估计样本清洁度，并利用历史模型与当前模型的协同机制模拟人类习惯形成，实现含噪声三元组条件下的鲁棒组合图像检索。

papers.title: ReTrack: Evidence-Driven Dual-Stream Directional Anchor Calibration Network for Composed Video Retrieval
papers.authors: Zixu Li, Yupeng Hu, Zhiwei Chen, Qinlei Huang, Guozhi Qiu, Zhiheng Fu, Meng Liu
papers.tags: video search, multimodal learning, video segmentation
papers.affiliations: School of Software, Shandong University; School of Computer Science and Technology, Shandong Jianzhu University
papers.intro: ReTrack是首个通过校准组合特征方向性偏差来提升多模态查询理解的CVR框架，利用语义贡献解耦、组合几何校准和可靠证据驱动对齐三个模块，在CVR和CIR任务上均达到SOTA性能。

papers.title: On the Reliability of Computer Use Agents
papers.authors: Gonzalo Gonzalez-Pumariega, Saaket Agashe, Jiachen Yang, Ang Li, Xin Eric Wang
papers.affiliations: 未明确（通讯地址为 Simular, simular.ai，具体作者归属未在文中列出）
papers.intro: 本文通过系统实验分析计算机使用代理在重复执行中不可靠性的三个来源（执行随机性、指令模糊性、规划可变性），并利用配对统计测试揭示可靠性不仅取决于任务规格，还取决于代理行为随运行的变化，进而提出评估和改进可靠性的建议。

papers.title: Where to Focus: Query-Modulated Multimodal Keyframe Selection for Long Video Understanding
papers.authors: Shaoguang Wang, Weiyu Guo, Ziyang Chen, Xuming Hu, Hui Xiong
papers.tags: multimodal learning, video segmentation, object detection, CLIP, video search
papers.affiliations: 香港科技大学（广州）人工智能方向（Shaoguang Wang, Weiyu Guo, Ziyang Chen, Xuming Hu）；香港科技大学计算机科学与工程系（Hui Xiong）
papers.intro: Q-Gate提出了一种无需训练、即插即用的查询调制门控框架，将关键帧选择建模为动态模态路由问题，通过LLM分析查询意图并动态分配三个互补专家流（视觉定位、全局匹配、上下文对齐）的注意力权重，从而在长视频理解中最大化信噪比并显著超越现有基线。

papers.title: Towards Realistic Open-Vocabulary Remote Sensing Segmentation: Benchmark and Baseline
papers.authors: Bingyu Li, Tao Huo, Haocheng Dong, Da Zhang, Zhiyuan Zhao, Junyu Gao, Xuelong Li
papers.affiliations: University of Science and Technology of China (Bingyu Li, Haocheng Dong); Northwestern Polytechnical University (Tao Huo, Da Zhang, Junyu Gao); TeleAI, China Telecom (Bingyu Li, Tao Huo, Haocheng Dong, Da Zhang, Junyu Gao, Zhiyuan Zhao, Xuelong Li)
papers.intro: 本文构建了大规模应用导向的开放词汇遥感分割基准OVRSISBenchV2（含OVRSIS95K训练集）并提出基于正激励噪声机制的Pi-Seg基线方法，显著提升遥感域下开放词汇分割的泛化能力。

papers.title: Causal Bootstrapped Alignment for Unsupervised Video-Based Visible-Infrared Person Re-Identification
papers.authors: Shuang Li, Jiaxu Leng, Changjiang Kuang, Mingpi Tan, Yu Yuan, Xinbo Gao
papers.affiliations: School of Computer Science and Technology, Chongqing University of Posts and Telecommunications, Chongqing, China
papers.intro: 本文提出因果引导对齐（CBA）框架，通过因果干预热身（CIW）与原型引导不确定性细化（PGUR），在无标注视频tracklet上实现可见光-红外跨模态身份表示学习，首次建立USL-VVI-ReID任务并取得显著优于现有扩展方法的结果。

papers.title: Beyond Visual Cues: Semantic-Driven Token Filtering and Expert Routing for Anytime Person ReID
papers.authors: Jiaxuan Li, Xin Wen, Zhihang Li
papers.tags: multimodal learning, image retrieval, tracking, video search
papers.affiliations: 清华大学、独立研究者、中国科学院大学
papers.intro: 本文提出STFER（Semantic-driven Token Filtering and Expert Routing）框架，利用大型视觉语言模型生成的“身份固有语义文本”作为稳定先验，通过语义驱动的视觉Token过滤和专家路由，显著提升任意时刻行人再识别在模态切换与换装场景下的鲁棒性。

papers.title: One Token per Highly Selective Frame: Towards Extreme Compression for Long Video Understanding
papers.authors: Zheyu Zhang, Ziqi Pang, Shixing Chen, Xiang Hao, Vimal Bhat, Yu-Xiong Wang
papers.tags: video segmentation, multimodal learning, video generation, video search
papers.affiliations: University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign; Amazon Prime Video
papers.intro: 本文提出XComp框架，通过可学习渐进式token级压缩（LP-Comp）和问题条件帧级压缩（QC-Comp）实现每帧仅保留一个token的极端压缩，使VLM能够处理2-4倍更多的视频帧并提升长视频理解性能。

papers.title: ClusterRAG: Cluster-Based Collaborative Filtering for Personalized Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.authors: Gibson Nkhata, Uttamasha Anjally Oyshi, Quan Mai, Susan Gauch
papers.affiliations: University of Arkansas（作者1、2、4），Walmart Inc.（作者3）
papers.intro: ClusterRAG提出一种基于密度聚类和协同过滤的个性化RAG框架，通过对用户画像聚类、检索同簇相似用户的文档并与目标用户自身文档自适应组合，在不同检索器和生成模型上均稳定提升了个性化生成的效果。
